sobre: End-to-end encrypted group chat. The server does not know who is in which group or its name: that stays only on the devices of the people in the group.

lista.nomeDica: Up to 60 characters. The name stays only on the devices of the people in the group; the server does not see it.
lista.vazio: No groups yet. Create one and invite, by @, people who already talk with you.
lista.esperando: Joining “{grupo}”… The person who invited you needs to open Alumia for this to finish.
lista.fora: You are no longer in this group

conversa.vazio: No messages here. People who join only read what arrives after they join.
conversa.fora: You are no longer in this group: the person who manages it removed you, or the group was deleted from this device. Messages already here stay until they expire.
conversa.suspeito: Security warning: this group received a change that does not check out (someone tried to change who is in it or who manages it). Nothing was accepted. If it keeps happening, create a new group.
conversa.lead: End-to-end encrypted. People who left do not read new messages; people who join do not read old ones.

pessoas.explica: This list exists only on the devices of the people in the group, inside the encryption. The server does not have it.
pessoas.conferida: @ checked against the public key log
pessoas.naoConfere: Warning: this person's key does not match the public log. Do not trust it until you compare the safety code.
pessoas.codigoExplica: It is the same code as your one-to-one conversation with this person. Compare in person or another way: if it matches, no one is in the middle.
pessoas.tirarConfirma: Remove @{nome} from the group? They will stop reading new messages.

convidar.dica: You can only invite people who already have an open conversation with you: the invitation goes encrypted through it. They accept or decline.
convidar.enviado: Invitation sent to @{nome}. They accept or decline on their device.

sair.confirma: Leave the group “{grupo}”? Its messages disappear from this device and you stop receiving new ones.

erros.grupo_sem_conversa: To invite, first open a one-to-one conversation with this person (the invitation goes encrypted through it).
erros.grupo_ja_esta: This person is already in the group.
erros.grupo_sou_eu: You are already in the group.
erros.sem_papel: Only the person who manages the group can do this.
erros.grupo_fora: You are no longer in this group.
erros.grupo_ocupado: The group changed at the same time on another device. Try again.
erros.nome_invalido: Write a name of up to 60 characters.
erros.texto_invalido: Write a message of up to 2000 characters.
erros.dm_sem_chave: Turn on messages on this device to use groups.
erros.motor_ocupado: Groups are already open in another tab of this browser. Close the other tab and try again.
erros.generico: That did not work right now. Try again in a moment.
